name: Yang He
bio: Yang He received the B.S. degree in optical information science and engineering from Shandong Normal University and the M.S. and Ph.D. degrees in physics from the Harbin Institute of Technology. After receiving the Ph.D. degree, Yang He worked at Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC). Yang He is currently a postdoctoral fellow / visiting scholar at Peking University.
bioZh: 何阳本科毕业于山东师范大学光电信息科学与工程专业，硕士、博士毕业于哈尔滨工业大学物理学专业，博士毕业后曾在长江存储工作，现为北京大学博士后/访问学者。
